claim: 1000ms held-key cliff is a benchmark/input-shape artifact
falsifying_observation: tap-then-wait or fixed-short-hold controls reproduce the same cliff after matching startup state and retained-key filtering
negative_control: paired tap, 50ms hold, 100ms hold, and held-key rows in the same fresh-editor topology
action_if_falsified: reopen input-shape wording and rerun cross-browser controls

claim: Chrome, Firefox, and Safari dips share benchmark ordering rather than one Chrome EventDispatch bug
falsifying_observation: one browser loses the dip after the same held-key and persistence-boundary controls while the others retain it
negative_control: same delay grid, key mode, retained-key rule, and persistence markers across browsers

claim: Retained Typing q50 is stable enough only for retained typing, not first input after idle
falsifying_observation: first retained key or first undiscarded key remains wait-sensitive while aggregate q50 looks flat
negative_control: per-keypress distributions with and without CI throwaway under matched startup waits
action_if_falsified: add or rename idle-input metric; do not hide it in q50

claim: Reducing startup wait can save runtime only after readiness fields pass
falsifying_observation: shorter startup wait improves q50 but increases failures, retries, late resources, or preview/canvas movement
negative_control: real Performance Tests topology with failures, resources, retries, first keys, and retained rows
action_if_falsified: block wait reduction until readiness predicate or fallback is validated

claim: Pattern fixed wait can be replaced by a source predicate
falsifying_observation: predicate fires before block patterns, previews, canvas, or resources are stable in any target lane
negative_control: fixed 500ms/1000ms control plus predicate and predicate-plus-resource-quiet arms
action_if_falsified: keep fixed fallback or add resource guard

claim: Selector guard is a safe source-level optimization
falsifying_observation: behavior fixtures fail or targeted source spans do not collapse even when aggregate p50 moves
negative_control: behavior fixtures first, source-span microscope second, aggregate p50 last
action_if_falsified: do not cite aggregate timing; narrow or abandon patch

claim: Store subscriber partition is compatible with public data semantics
falsifying_observation: public subscribe order, dynamic dependency, or persistence selector compatibility changes under partitioning
negative_control: public compatibility matrix and marker-only fanout control
action_if_falsified: veto public-path partition; keep private side-channel only

claim: Sidecar can name runtime mechanism without perturbing the benchmark
falsifying_observation: sidecar changes fast/slow ordering or fails to join retained keys to helper, renderer, command, and clock rows
negative_control: observer-off baseline, passive sidecar, and repeated runtime-checkpoint control
action_if_falsified: keep empirical wording; do not run heavier tracing

claim: CPU/QoS counters explain the remaining fast/slow classes
falsifying_observation: joined frequency, residency, QoS, cache, or runnable-latency counters do not separate classes or perturb ordering
negative_control: accepted passive sidecar plus root counter run with ordering preservation
action_if_falsified: keep empirical CPU-state sensitivity or escalate to root trace

claim: Fixed-x workload is enough to choose source owners
falsifying_observation: selection, deletion, paste, IME, block-structure, plugin-heavy, or pattern workloads show different owners or opposite effects
negative_control: per-stratum replay with assertions and source spans
action_if_falsified: limit source conclusions to strata that reproduce the owner/effect

claim: Chromium-internal visual endpoints approximate user-visible presentation
falsifying_observation: OCR, present, or camera endpoint ordering disagrees with screenshot/paint/DrawFrame ordering
negative_control: calibrated external endpoint ladder joined to retained-key windows

claim: Repository q50 display predicts CI pass/fail
falsifying_observation: dashboard, reviewer workflow, or noisy-metric policy uses thresholds or comparisons that do not match printed q50
negative_control: archived Performance Tests artifacts joined to dashboard/reviewer decisions
action_if_falsified: do not predict pass/fail from local or repository q50
